content:
Atlantic Airways opens up a range of travel features for its travelers. Travelers about to fly with their companions can also procure the dedicated group travel facility here. This travel offering of the airline lets a group of individuals organize their gateways as per their requirements. On top of that, the Atlantic Airways Group Travel expedition consists of unique travel offers to let every member enjoy their journey with more ease. But there are many other features and provisions of group travel options. Moreover, travelers can get in-depth information about these by taking a look below.

Does Atlantic Airways Do Group Bookings?

Indeed! Atlantic Airways does group bookings. But when a number of flyers are included under the same itinerary, it calls for a little attention to the conditions attached to the group reservation. Getting familiar with these rules beforehand would make it easier to plan the reservation without missing an important requirement. From the following points, one can learn about these policies in detail.

  • Core Requirements: At least 10 adults or children between 2 and 11 years old must travel together for a similar purpose.
  • Route Changes: Changes to the route may not be allowed once the tickets have been issued.
  • Name Changes: Names can be changed free of charge before ticketing. Changes after ticketing may involve a fee.
  • Travel Documents: Travelers in the group have to carry the valid documents required for the journey.
  • Payment Requirements: Group tickets must be paid in full no later than 30 days before departure, with a non refundable deposit required.

How to Book Group Flights on Atlantic Airways?

Travelers planning to head towards the same destination with their companions on an Atlantic Airways flight have to first send their booking request. When the required number of seats is available, the airline will proceed further with the reservation process. Moreover, travelers can submit their Atlantic Airways group booking request via its official website. This booking approach allows them to share all their travel details in a single form. The complete steps for making group reservations are explained below.

  1. Go to the official Atlantic Airways website.
  2. Hover over "Group bookings" on the homepage.
  3. Then, choose the "Start" button to begin the request.
  4. Now, send the form with the required details.
  5. Soon, the airline will check the request and provide a fare quote with a deadline.
  6. Check the offer and make the required payment within the given time.
  7. Submit the passenger details as shown on their travel documents.
  8. After confirmation, the ticket details will be sent to the group leader’s email.

Can You Get Group Discounts on Atlantic Airways?

Yes! Group discounts while flying with Atlantic Airways can be obtained. But the airline states that groups with at least 10 passengers traveling on the same route can enjoy these discounted fares. Also, these offers might depend on availability, routes, travel timing, and many other factors. So, it can be concluded that getting group discounts is possible when all the required stipulations of the airline have been met.

Conclusion

Overall, groups can fly on Atlantic Airways flights smoothly. Moreover, travelers are not required to make separate reservations for all members. By raising a group booking request through the method explained above, they can all fly together under one itinerary. Additionally, the airline might offer them discounts when they comply with its terms and conditions properly. So, due to all these benefits, flying with Atlantic Airways in a group is a worthwhile option.
